reviews.name: Mahmudul Hasan Rahat
reviews.review_text: Before One Agent BD, we used to lose late-night Facebook inquiries because no one was online after midnight. Now the AI replies in 2 seconds, checks available sizes, and confirms COD orders while we sleep.

reviews.name: Sadia Afrin Tisha
reviews.review_text: Customers constantly send product screenshots and voice notes on Instagram and Messenger. The AI recognizes product photos accurately, quotes the exact price, and handles the entire checkout conversation.

reviews.name: Tanvir Ahmed Chowdhury
reviews.review_text: The auto comment-to-inbox workflow and 1-click Steadfast courier booking saved our team hours of manual data entry every single day. Best automation platform we have used.

reviews.name: Ariful Islam Sourav
reviews.review_text: During peak season we receive hundreds of WhatsApp messages daily. One Agent BD collects customer names, phone numbers, and full delivery addresses and logs every order into our dashboard.

reviews.name: Nusrat Jahan Mim
reviews.review_text: Connecting our Facebook Page and Instagram took less than two minutes. Whenever a buyer asks for a live call, the AI alerts our team in the Call Requests queue immediately.

reviews.review_text: Our ad conversion rate nearly doubled because customers get an instant response right after clicking our boosted posts. Smart follow-ups bring back hesitant buyers automatically.
